moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 142,000 coins. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +5.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.
